scenarios.title: Etsy gidiş etiketi siparişe bağlanmıyor: shipped_at geriye dönük boş

-- Beklenen: n_intl_negative_margin = 0, n_intl_refund_without_return_cost = 0. Ölçüm 2026-11-08 Jade: 610 sipariş, negatif marj 1, iade kargo kaydı eksik 47, gelir 1949075, etiket 205515 cent.
with o as (select id from organizations where name = 'Jade Gold NYC'),
 intl as (select s.id, s.status, s.shipping_cents,
            (select coalesce(sum(c.amount_cents), 0) from costs c where c.sale_id = s.id and c.cost_kind = 'shipping_label') as label_cents,
            (select coalesce(sum(c.amount_cents), 0) from costs c where c.sale_id = s.id and c.cost_kind = 'return_label') as return_cents
          from sales s, o
          where s.org_id = o.id and s.ship_country <> 'US' and s.status in ('completed', 'partially_refunded', 'refunded'))
select count(*) as n_intl,
       count(*) filter (where label_cents > 0 and shipping_cents < label_cents) as n_intl_negative_margin,
       count(*) filter (where status in ('refunded', 'partially_refunded') and return_cents = 0) as n_intl_refund_without_return_cost,
       sum(shipping_cents) as intl_shipping_income_cents, sum(label_cents) as intl_label_cents
from intl;

-- Beklenen: rol kolonu kurulunca n_multi_label_orders ve n_non_order_shipments için sınıflandırılmamış satır 0. Ölçüm 2026-11-08 Jade: 3 çok-etiketli sipariş (4439 cent), 29 siparişsiz gönderi (32788 cent).
with o as (select id from organizations where name = 'Jade Gold NYC'),
 multi as (select c.sale_id, count(*) as n, sum(c.amount_cents) as cents
           from costs c, o where c.org_id = o.id and c.cost_kind = 'shipping_label' and c.external_key is not null
           group by c.sale_id having count(*) > 1),
 nonorder as (select sh.shipment_id, sh.shipment_cost_cents + coalesce(sh.insurance_cost_cents, 0) as cents
              from shipstation_shipments sh, o
              where sh.org_id = o.id and not coalesce(sh.voided, false)
                and not exists (select 1 from sales s where s.org_id = sh.org_id and s.etsy_receipt_id::text = sh.order_number))
select (select count(*) from multi) as n_multi_label_orders, (select coalesce(sum(cents), 0) from multi) as multi_label_cents,
       (select count(*) from nonorder) as n_non_order_shipments, (select coalesce(sum(cents), 0) from nonorder) as non_order_cents;
